jobs.prompt: Train 2, bug B13 (guard, fails open). tools/shell-writes.mjs omWriteTargetRel (used by omWordsRedirectManifestArea to stop orchestrator shell redirects into coordination/manifests/ or .swarm/) resolves the ROOT's real path (fs.realpathSync.native(ctx.root)) but compares it with the TARGET's unresolved absolute path. When the project root sits behind a symlink (macOS /tmp -> /private/tmp, or any symlinked checkout) and the target is given as an absolute or cwd-relative path through the symlinked form, path.relative(rootReal, abs) starts with '..', the function returns null, and a redirect into the manifest area is NOT detected. Fix: resolve the target the same way as the root before comparing: realpath of the nearest existing ancestor of the target (the file itself may not exist yet), then re-append the missing tail; also resolve ctx.cwd through realpath before resolving a relative target. tools/orchestrator-allow.mjs already has projectRelOfAbs / orchestratorWriteAllowed doing this (read it; reuse an exported helper if one fits, otherwise implement the same nearest-existing-parent logic locally). Keep returning null for a target genuinely outside the root and for $-expanded words. Also make the '..' test per segment (rel === '..' or rel.startsWith('../')) so a real name like '..foo' is not treated as outside. Tests in NEW tests/om-redirect-realpath.test.mjs (first import: import './_isolate-config.mjs';): create a temp project, a symlink pointing to it, and call orchestratorModeCommandAllowed with ctx.root set to the SYMLINK path and the command `echo x > <real path>/coordination/manifests/a.json`, then with root = real path and the target through the symlink, then with a relative target and cwd given through the symlink: all must be refused (false). A redirect to a normal allowed path (e.g. docs/plans/x.md) is still allowed in the same setups. Use the orchestrator-mode fixture pattern from tests/orchestrator-mode.test.mjs. The ignored tests cover other guard behaviour, which must not change; the coordinator runs the main ones as checks.
